string.name: wear_day_night_day_title
string.comment: Title of the main Custom watch face on the Wear screen when a night face is also set. %1$s=name of the watch face. Example: Day face: AAPS V2

string.name: wear_day_night_both_title
string.comment: Title of the main Custom watch face on the Wear screen when no night face is set, so this face shows day and night. %1$s=name of the watch face. Example: Day and night face: AAPS V2

string.name: wear_day_night_night_title
string.comment: Title of the night Custom watch face on the Wear screen. %1$s=name of the watch face. Example: Night face: Cyberpunk

resources.string: No night face. The face above shows day and night.

string.name: wear_day_night_load_night_face
string.comment: Button: choose a watch face file and send it to the watch as the night face

string.name: wear_day_night_remove_night_face
string.comment: Button: the watch forgets its night face and shows the day face day and night

string.name: wear_day_night_select_night_face
string.comment: Title of the list of watch face files when loading a night face

string.name: wear_day_night_look
string.comment: Setting: when the watch shows the day face and when the night face

string.name: wear_day_night_look_auto
string.comment: Choice of the setting Day / night look: day face from sunrise to sunset, night face at night

string.name: wear_day_night_face_day
string.comment: Choice of the settings Day / night look and Always-on look: always show the day face

string.name: wear_day_night_face_night
string.comment: Choice of the settings Day / night look and Always-on look: always show the night face

string.name: wear_day_night_always_on_look
string.comment: Setting: which face the always-on (ambient) screen of the watch shows

string.name: wear_day_night_always_on_look_active
string.comment: Choice of the setting Always-on look: the same face as the active screen shows at that moment
